purpose: Teach: マッチ/アホ/佐々木/岐阜/さぁ/たまる/珠/うめ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママ、家具のマッチングを考えてるの
lines.en: Sho, I'm thinking about matching furniture pieces.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational opening. A mother thinking aloud, not waiting for a response. Warm but slightly distracted, like her mind is half on the task ahead.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがぼくに「アホって言うな」っておこったの
lines.en: Mom, Dad got mad at me for saying 'aho.'
lines.style: Small, uncertain voice. Not defensive—more checking in, seeking reassurance. A child testing whether he did something genuinely wrong. Eyes on her face.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、佐々木さんが、お父さんのお仕事仲間よ
lines.en: Sho, Sasaki-san is one of your father's colleagues at work.
lines.style: Soft, explanatory tone. Patient but steady—she's clarifying something she doesn't think was meant unkindly. No edge, just gentle context-setting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんと岐阜に行きたいな
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to Gifu with Grandma.
lines.style: Bright shift in energy. A new idea just arrived and he's already excited. Slightly higher pitch, eager. The kind of sudden want kids announce without preamble.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、さぁ、ご飯ですよ
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. A gentle redirect, the tone a parent uses when pulling attention back to what's immediate. Not impatient, just present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの貯金、たまるのが楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm looking forward to my savings growing.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely pleased. He's discovered something small he can count on. Steady tone, pride understated but there. Shares this like a quiet discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの珠のネックレス、おばあちゃんからの贈り物よ
lines.en: Sho, this pearl necklace—it's a gift from your grandmother.
lines.style: Tender, slightly reverent opening. She's holding something precious and her voice carries that. Warm explanation, connecting him to something that matters across time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うめぼし、美味しいよね。ママ、お庭の梅、いい香りだね
lines.en: Umeboshi really is delicious, isn't it? Mom, the plum tree in the garden smells so good.
lines.style: Delighted observation, noticing the world. Starts quiet and pleased, then brightens as he reaches the second thought. Small-child delight in scent and taste and connection.
